title: Total variation distance as half the $\ell^1$ distance
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite discrete measurable space, and let $\mu$ and $\nu$ be probability measures on $\Omega$. Then the total variation distance between $\mu$ and $\nu$ equals half the sum, over all points $\omega \in \Omega$, of the absolute differences of their point masses:
\[
  \mathrm{TV}(\mu,\nu) \;=\; \frac{1}{2}\sum_{\omega \in \Omega}
    \abs{\mu(\{\omega\}) - \nu(\{\omega\})}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $\Omega$ is a finite discrete measurable space
